about: Part-time freelance bookkeeper with five small-business clients, plus family mail

messages.subject: October receipts
messages.body:
Hi Annelies,

October receipts are uploaded to the shared folder. Sorry they're late, it was a crazy month with all the water heater calls.

Dale

messages.subject: Re: October receipts
messages.body:
Thanks Dale! No worries. I'll have October reconciled by the 10th.

Annelies

messages.subject: November stuff + van question
messages.body:
Hi Annelies,

November receipts are in the folder. One question: I bought a used van on the 12th for $18,400, financed through the dealer. Does that go in as an expense or do we depreciate it?

Also the shop has a new phone number, it's on the invoices now.

Thanks,
Dale
Brightwater Plumbing | leaks, water heaters, drains

messages.subject: Re: November stuff + van question
messages.body:
Hi Dale,

The van gets capitalized and depreciated, not expensed all at once. Could you send me the loan papers from the dealer so I can set up the loan balance? I've updated the phone number on your profile too.

Annelies

messages.subject: Copy of our engagement letter?
messages.body:
Hi Annelies,

My bank wants a copy of our engagement letter (the one we signed when I started with you) for the line of credit application. Could you send me a PDF when you get a sec? No rush before Friday.

Thanks,
Dale / Brightwater Plumbing

messages.subject: Your desk agreement renews January 1
messages.body:
Hi Annelies,

Just a heads up that your desk agreement at Cedar Row renews on January 1. The rate stays at $210/month. Please sign the renewal form (attached) and send it back by December 15.

Thanks!
Dale Kimura
Member Services, Cedar Row Workspace

messages.subject: October statements
messages.body:
Hi Annelies,

Attached are the October statements for the checking account and the card. The big deposit on the 14th is the Whitfield wedding.

Best,
Priya Fennick
Fennick Florals

messages.subject: Re: October statements
messages.body:
Got them, thanks Priya. Everything looks normal at first glance.

Annelies

messages.subject: Greenleaf says invoice 4471 is unpaid??
messages.body:
Hi Annelies,

Greenleaf Stems says invoice 4471 is still open, $1,212.50 for the October wedding flowers. I'm pretty sure I paid it by bank transfer in early November. Can you check whether it shows in the books? I'd hate to pay it twice.

Priya

messages.subject: November statements
messages.body:
Hi Annelies,

November statements attached. Also, when is my Q4 estimated tax payment due again? I always forget.

Thanks!
Priya

messages.subject: Re: November statements
messages.body:
Hi Priya,

Thanks! The Q4 estimate is due January 15. I'll send you the amount once November is closed.

Annelies

messages.subject: Bank feed stuck
messages.body:
Hi Annelies,

The bank feed in Tallybook hasn't pulled anything in since Oct 28. I tried reconnecting but it just spins forever. Should I download the statements by hand for now?

Thanks,
Hannah

messages.subject: Re: Bank feed stuck
messages.body:
Hi Hannah,

Don't download anything yet. Tallybook has a problem on their end with some bank feeds. I'll keep an eye on it and let you know when it's working again.

Annelies

messages.subject: Bankverbindung in Tallybook
messages.body:
Hallo Annelies,

seit Ende Oktober werden die Umsätze von meinem Geschäftskonto nicht mehr in Tallybook importiert. Ich habe die Verbindung schon zweimal neu eingerichtet, aber es klappt einfach nicht. Kannst du bitte mal schauen?

Danke und viele Grüße
Katrin

messages.subject: Known issue: bank feeds delayed
messages.body:
Some bank feeds have been delayed since October 28. Please don't reconnect affected accounts. Transactions will import automatically once the issue is fixed. We'll post an update here.

The Tallybook team

messages.subject: Resolved: bank feeds restored
messages.body:
The bank feed delay is fixed. All delayed transactions since October 28 have been imported. No action is needed on your side.

The Tallybook team

messages.subject: Re: Bank feed stuck
messages.body:
Good news, everything from October showed up this morning! Thanks for telling me not to mess with it.

H.

messages.subject: Re: Bankverbindung in Tallybook
messages.body:
Hallo Katrin,

danke für die Nachricht. Das ist gerade ein bekanntes Problem bei Tallybook, nicht nur bei dir. Die arbeiten daran. Bitte richte die Verbindung nicht noch einmal neu ein, ich schaue nächste Woche wieder nach.

Viele Grüße
Annelies

messages.subject: Re: Bankverbindung in Tallybook
messages.body:
Hallo Annelies,

es funktioniert wieder! Alle Umsätze sind jetzt da, auch die vom 28. Oktober. Danke für deine Hilfe.

Liebe Grüße
Katrin

messages.subject: Where does invoice 4471 go?
messages.body:
Hi Annelies,

Quick one: I got invoice 4471 from the Maplewood Community Center for the room we rent on Saturdays for the kids' class. Should that go under rent or under program costs? It's $640 for the fall session.

Thanks!
Hannah

messages.subject: November receipts + mats
messages.body:
Hi Annelies,

November receipts are in the folder. I bought 20 new mats for $1,150, is that an expense or equipment? I'll send the receipt for the mats tomorrow, it's still in my car.

Hannah
Linden Yoga Studio

messages.subject: Re: November receipts + mats
messages.body:
Hi Hannah,

At that price per mat you can expense them as supplies. Thanks for the receipt when you find it.

Annelies

messages.subject: Aangifte vierde kwartaal
messages.body:
Hoi Annelies,

Sorry dat ik het nog een keer stuur, ik weet niet of mijn vorige mail aangekomen is (die kwam van mijn privéadres). Wanneer moet de aangifte voor het vierde kwartaal binnen zijn? En moet ik nog bonnetjes aanleveren?

Groet,
Joost Verhaegen
Café Rozenhof

messages.subject: Belege Oktober
messages.body:
Hallo Annelies,

anbei die Belege für Oktober. Die Rechnung vom Holzhändler kommt noch, er hat sie mir noch nicht geschickt.

Viele Grüße
Katrin Brandt
Holzwerk Brandt

messages.subject: Vraagje over de kwartaalaangifte
messages.body:
Hoi Annelies,

Ik heb een vraag over de kwartaalaangifte voor de sales tax. Wanneer moet die van het vierde kwartaal binnen zijn, en heb je nog iets van mij nodig? Ik wil het graag op tijd regelen, vorig jaar werd het een beetje krap.

Groetjes,
Joost

messages.subject: Re: Aangifte vierde kwartaal
messages.body:
Hoi Joost,

Beide mails zijn aangekomen, geen zorgen. De aangifte voor het vierde kwartaal moet uiterlijk 31 januari binnen zijn. Ik heb alles van oktober al, dus ik heb alleen de bonnetjes van november en december nog nodig. Die kun je gewoon begin januari sturen.

Groetjes,
Annelies

messages.subject: Bonnetjes oktober
messages.body:
Hoi Annelies,

Hierbij de bonnetjes van oktober. De rekening van de koffiebranderij zit er ook bij, die was dit keer wat hoger.

Fijne avond!
Joost

messages.subject: Re: Bonnetjes oktober
messages.body:
Dank je Joost, alles is binnen. Ik verwerk het deze week.

Groet,
Annelies

messages.subject: Bonnetjes november
messages.body:
Hoi Annelies,

Hier zijn de bonnetjes van november. Er zit ook een nieuwe rekening bij voor de vaatwasser, die hebben wij vorige week vervangen. Laat maar weten als je nog iets mist.

Groetjes,
Joost

messages.subject: Invoice CR-1188
messages.body:
Hello Annelies,

Invoice CR-1188 for your November desk membership is attached: $210.00, due November 1. You can pay online or drop off a check at the front desk.

Cedar Row Workspace

messages.subject: This week: the new mileage rate and five reconcile shortcuts
messages.body: In this issue: the new standard mileage rate, five shortcuts for faster bank reconciles, and reader Q&A on petty cash. Read online or unsubscribe anytime.

messages.subject: Year-end is coming: build your client checklist
messages.body: Year-end is six weeks away. This week: a printable client checklist, how to record gift cards, and why you should lock prior periods. Plus a reader asks how to price catch-up work.

messages.subject: Your tax-deadline calendar for the new year
messages.body: Pin this: January 15 for Q4 estimated payments, January 31 for W-2s, March 16 for partnership returns, April 15 for individual returns. Also: a quick refresher on extensions.

messages.subject: Your Tallybook receipt
messages.body: Thanks for your payment. Tallybook Practice plan, monthly: $45.00, charged to the card ending 0412.

messages.subject: Your October statement is ready
messages.body: Your October statement for checking ending 7730 is ready to view in online banking.

messages.subject: Taking new clients?
messages.body:
Hi Annelies,

Your name came up at the small business meetup last week. I run a two-person tile company and I need someone for monthly bookkeeping. Are you taking on new clients?

Owen Tasker
Tasker Tile

messages.subject: Re: Taking new clients?
messages.body:
Hi Owen,

Thanks for thinking of me. I'm full until March, but I'd be happy to talk then.

Best,
Annelies

messages.subject: faucet again
messages.body:
Hey, the kitchen faucet is dripping again, worse than last time. Can you call someone this week? I'm on the Fairview job site every day until Friday.

Love, T

messages.subject: Re: faucet again
messages.body: Ugh. I'll call someone Monday morning. Put a bowl under it for now?

messages.subject: Thanksgiving
messages.body:
Hi sweetheart,

Are you coming here for Thanksgiving this year or going to Teo's family? Let me know so I can plan the turkey. Not too big this time, I still have leftovers in the freezer from last year!

Love, Mom

messages.subject: Re: Thanksgiving
messages.body: Hi Mom, we're coming to you! I'll bring the pies. Love, A

messages.subject: Letter from my plan
messages.body:
Hi honey,

I got a letter from my Medicare plan about changes for next year and I don't understand half of it. Can you look at it when you're here Thursday? It's on the fridge.

Mom

messages.subject: lake pics
messages.body:
Hi sis! Back from the lake, here are some photos. Milo would have loved the canoe. Next year you guys have to come.

F

messages.subject: Mom's 70th
messages.body:
Mom turns 70 on December 20 (can you believe it). Want to go in together on something? I was thinking a nice piece of jewelry, maybe the garnet earrings she keeps looking at downtown. Let me know what you think.

F

messages.subject: Brookside News: picture day and book fair
messages.body: Picture day is this Thursday. The fall book fair runs all next week in the library. Volunteers are always welcome!

messages.subject: Brookside News: winter concert
messages.body: The winter concert is December 11 at 6 pm in the school theater. Enrollment for spring after-school clubs opens December 1.

messages.subject: End-of-season party Saturday
messages.body:
Hi soccer families,

What a season! Party is Saturday at 4 at Kessler Field. Please reply with what dish you'll bring so we don't end up with six bags of chips.

Coach Ray

messages.subject: Re: End-of-season party Saturday
messages.body:
Hi Ray, we'll bring a big pasta salad. Thanks for a great season, Milo loved it.

Annelies

messages.subject: ladder
messages.body: Hey Annelies, could I borrow your extension ladder Saturday? Gutters again. Gus

messages.subject: Re: ladder
messages.body: Sure, it's in the garage. The side door is open.

messages.subject: Your prescription is ready

This is Marta from Lakeview Dental. Please confirm your cleaning on December 3 at 8:30 am. Reply to this email or call the front desk.

Thank you!
Marta

messages.subject: Belege November
messages.body:

hier sind die Belege für November. Die Rechnung vom Holzhändler für Oktober ist auch dabei, sorry für die Verspätung.

traps.what: Two people with the first name Dale want a signed agreement, but one is a client's engagement letter and the other the owner's desk renewal.
Priya and Hannah both mention invoice 4471, but they are different vendors; the shared number is chance.
Teo needs a plumber and client Dale runs a plumbing shop, but hiring a client for home repairs joins personal and work.
Two clients reported the same bank feed outage, but the vendor fixed it and both confirmed it works again.
Two sales tax questions are Joost asking once from each of his addresses, already answered.
